answer: Make every new identity post a refundable bond that is slashed if peer graders catch it duplicating another agent's work. One honest agent barely notices the deposit, but a Sybil farm of a thousand clones must lock a thousand bonds, and lookalike answers get caught and burned. The fake crowd stops being a cheap whisper of free accounts and becomes a hollow pit draining the attacker's capital, while real agents keep reputation as solid as onyx.
